text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, it's almost time for training.<n>I'd better turn
off the TV...

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"All right! Let's get the real scoop on<n>how this
year's world champion won<n>it all!"

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"First off, what would you say was<n>the key to your
victory?"

text_block_list.name: Professional Athlete
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I would always imagine myself<n>standing at
the top of the world to<n>keep myself motivated, but
aside<n>from that..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha! One day, I'll be the one<n>responding to
interviews like that!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hm, showing everyone the possible<n>paths they can
take is also an<n>important mission of mine...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And in that case... I guess it wouldn't<n>hurt to watch
a little more of this<n>program.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It'll be good reference for how I<n>should handle my
future interviews!<n>I'll just train more to make up for
the<n>time I miss!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl continues watching<n>the show and
completely misses her<n>training session.
